paper.title: Examining inequality in the time cost of waiting

claims.claim: Supplementary Table 1 reports the likelihood of waiting, conditional waiting, service use, and conditional waiting duration for low and high income groups, without and with controls.
The article reports annualized gaps in time spent waiting under three service-use assumptions, with and without controls.
The article reports gender differences in common-service use, likelihood of waiting, and conditional waiting duration.

findings.description: The package omits the five ATUS source files required by 02_cleaning.do.
findings.evidence: The shipped data folder has atusall0319.dta and CPS_ASEC_selectvars_timeinequality.dta only; the run log records missing atusrost0319.dta, atuscps0319.dta, atusresp0319.dta, atussum0319.dta, and atusact0319.dta.
findings.suggested_fix: Provide the exact ATUS input files used by the authors, subject to their data-use terms.

findings.description: The imputation script references a poverty-threshold dataset absent from the package.
findings.evidence: 05_imputation.do merges draft\nature\check\federal_poverty_threshold.dta; no such file is present in the supplied package.
findings.suggested_fix: Provide the referenced poverty-threshold data file.

limitations: Stata was unavailable. Only a pipeline-entry R translation and prerequisite check were executed; the full cleaning, table, figure, and imputation scripts were not translated command by command. Consequently, this is a technical-failure report, not a completed exhaustive check of all article results.

The article PDF is the supplied unedited author-format document. The current claim inventory captures selected numeric results from its first sections and Supplementary Table 1, not every result in all article text, figures, and tables.
The shipped atusall0319.dta is a preassembled analytic file, but the shipped master pipeline rebuilds it from missing raw files; no analysis was substituted using this intermediate file.

provenance.processed_data: atusall0319.dta (included, not substituted into a partial rerun)
